newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares close weaker but off lows.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares close weaker but off lows.

text.p: Swedish share prices dropped sharply in line with U.S. markets after U.S. purchasing manager figures indicated an upturn in the economy, but ended slightly off lows.
The general index plummeted 1.1 percent to 2,345.14 in a relatively low turnover of 2.53 billion crowns as many customers had taken the two-day week off.

But banking group Nordbanken bucked negative trends and leaped nine crowns to 215.5 crowns on continued merger rumours and on a Thursday newspaper report that Morgan Stanley placed the share on its priority list, dealers said.
Nordbanken has previously been riding on speculation about a merger with S-E-Banken, but S-E-Banken's share fell two crowns to 68.
Other banks were also pulled along in the general downturn. Swedbank dropped 3.50 crowns to 113.50 crowns and Handelsbanken fell two crowns to 194 crowns.
Bourse heavyweight pharmaceutical company Astra also fell, losing 2.5 crowns to 334.5 after having shown strength earlier in the day, nudging 338.5 crowns.
